name: ND Project Brief
description: On-demand project brief showing Git repository changes, tasks, blockers, and next actions with Markdown export.

tools.title: Project Brief
tools.description: Generate an on-demand status brief of repository changes, project tasks, blockers, and next actions.

tools.title: Export Project Brief
tools.description: Export the repository status brief as a formatted Markdown summary for standups and handoffs.

skills.title: Project Brief Skill
skills.description: Instructs the agent on using Project Brief tools to assess repository changes, track tasks, and export standup summaries.
skills.instructions: Use the project_brief tool to inspect current Git repository changes, review tasks in .project-brief/tasks.json, identify blocked or in-progress work, and determine deterministic next actions. Use project_brief_export to generate clean Markdown summaries for standups, reviews, or handoffs. Always respect the read-only workspace boundary.
